recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If FHIR-I wants to fully retire, relocate, or reintroduce current-list mechanics after the R6 lifecycle-page removal, handle that through a current issue or API Incubator follow-up rather than by reopening the original DSTU1 current-list application.
issue_request: FHIR-7551 was a Published FHIR-core search issue from DSTU1, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking the specification to document how a client can retrieve a patient's current medication, problem, allergy, and similar lists. The implementing comment directed the editor to document the _list parameter and proposed List ids plus functional-list literals such as $current-problems, $current-allergies, and $current-medications.
initial_application: The Jira comments record svn revision 5536. The corresponding git-svn commit fd0c054ffc746285deaa92e2219cf17ab9ed8ea2 changed source/lifecycle.html and source/search.html with the subject "#7551 - candidate solution for current X lists + fix search parameter xpath evaluation". Current source still contains _list documentation, current-list examples, and List-resource notes about querying List instances, raw resources, or Current resource lists, although the detailed lifecycle section that originally defined current lists has since been removed.
additional_context: FHIR-11271, already represented on the combined branch, was Published/Not Persuasive and reaffirmed that current-list membership is clinical/business-rule curation rather than generally derivable from resource status alone. FHIR-47135 reached a later No Change decision with the same rationale. FHIR-47134 requested additional expected-status guidance but remains Resolved - change required and is outside this run's Applied/Published source-edit scope. Git commit 270e0ceb7b029dad4ca0fc5ccf5296ff370888cd removed the detailed Current Resource Lists lifecycle text for R6 due to lack of implementation experience and pointed possible future work to the API Incubator. FHIR-39342 and related search-page reconciliations already handle the current _list/linking surface separately.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Re-adding the old FHIR-7551 lifecycle guidance would conflict with the later R6 removal, while removing or redesigning remaining _list functional-list references would be broader current-list policy cleanup that needs a separate applied issue or human/work-group review.
